title: EXPLOSIVE BARRELS
why: His answer 7 a: explosive barrels, clearly marked, red with a white X. Every raid, DEMO and CAREER alike, now has small clusters of red barrels with a white X on them, away from where you drop in and from the extraction points. A round that reaches one stops in it, and a little damage sets it off: it flickers for a moment and goes up. The blast hurts everything near it that it can see, you included, machines, pillagers and walls, and it sets off the barrels beside it, so a cluster goes up in a chain. A grenade sets them off too. Kills go to whoever set the barrel off. A barrel your teammate sets off never hurts you (no team damage). The barrels are placed on their own random stream, so the map, the enemies and the loot are exactly as before.
now: Red barrels with a white X now sit around every raid: shoot one and it explodes, setting off the barrels beside it.
